request.system:
You are shown the catalogue of an online shop: its name, country and products, with the checked facts we hold about each product. Draft a short store profile that the shop owner will read and correct.

- sells: two or three plain sentences on what the shop sells, by kind of product, as the catalogue shows it.
- audience: one or two sentences on who buys it, only as far as the products themselves show. Do not invent ages, incomes or lifestyles.
- tone: the voice that suits this catalogue for articles: "plain", "friendly" or "expert".

Use only what the catalogue shows. Write in English.

messages.content:
<shop>Northpaw Dog Supply</shop>
<country>US</country>
<products>
- Front-Clip No-Pull Harness (Harness) — Walking gear
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness is a harness.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness is made by Northpaw.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness is available in sizes XS, S, M, L, and XL.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness has a leash ring on the chest that turns the dog sideways when it pulls.
- Biothane Leash, 6 ft (Leash) — Walking gear
    - The Biothane Leash is 6 ft long.
    - The Biothane Leash is made of coated webbing that does not absorb water or smell.
    - The Biothane Leash is 5/8 in wide.
    - The Biothane Leash has a brass snap hook.
- Training Long Line, 30 ft (Leash) — Walking gear
    - The Training Long Line is 30 ft long.
    - The Training Long Line is a leash.
    - The Training Long Line is made by Northpaw.
    - The Training Long Line is made of lightweight biothane.
- Memory Foam Dog Bed (Bed) — Beds and blankets
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed is made by Northpaw.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed is available in sizes M and L.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed has 4 in of memory foam on a 1 in support base.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed has a removable cover.
- Fleece Dog Blanket (Blanket) — Beds and blankets
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket is made of double-layer polar fleece.
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket measures 40 × 30 in.
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket is machine washable.
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket can be tumble dried on low.
- Rechargeable LED Collar Light (Light) — Walking gear
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light clips onto any collar or harness.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light has three modes: steady, slow flash, and fast flash.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light is visible from about 1,000 ft.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light charges via USB-C.
</products>

content.text: {"sells":"Northpaw Dog Supply sells walking gear for dogs, including a front-clip no-pull harness, a 6 ft biothane leash, a 30 ft training long line and a rechargeable LED collar light. It also sells beds and blankets, namely a memory foam dog bed with a removable cover and a machine-washable fleece dog blanket.","audience":"Dog owners who walk and train their dogs, including those dealing with leash pulling or walking in low light, and who want a comfortable bed or blanket for their dog at home.","tone":"friendly"}
